source: Transcribed from the synthetic-case matrix in Hard Stop 2 (Design Review Package, Section 8), submitted to Canvas 2026-09-29. Written and committed BEFORE any harness run and before any elicited AHP vector exists, so ground truth cannot be adjusted after seeing results.
annotator: Manoj Venkatachalaiah (single annotator; a second annotator is still being sought, risk R-03)
tieBreakRule: If the top two scores differ by less than 0.02, the harness reports a near-tie and applies a documented deterministic rule: the lexicographically smaller shelterId wins. A tie is never resolved silently.

SYN-01.rationale: Critically injured: needs a vet. The nearest shelter has a vet on site and slots, so it is both nearest and vet-equipped.

SYN-02.rationale: Healthy and secured. The nearest shelter does not list rabbits; the second-nearest does. Exercises the species-match fix (SC1). The scenario is that the classifier emitted no accepts_species constraint (fixture flag classifierEmitsNoSpeciesConstraint).

SYN-03.rationale: Healthy and secured; all options are over 25 km and otherwise equal, so the nearer shelter should win.

SYN-04.rationale: Loose near a highway, reporter cannot hold it. The nearest shelter has zero slots, so the next-nearest shelter with slots is the best option.

SYN-05.rationale: Injured: needs a vet even if that shelter is farther. The nearest shelter has no vet; the second-nearest does.

SYN-06.rationale: Two shelters are identical on every factor. No shelter is annotated as best; the expected behaviour is a reported near-tie resolved by the documented tie-break rule (smaller shelterId), not a silent pick.

SYN-07.rationale: Mixed case: injured and loose in traffic. The near vet-equipped shelter should beat the nearer shelter without a vet. Exercises the blend.

SYN-08.rationale: Malformed classifier output must not crash and must produce the STABLE_ROUTINE fallback weights. The expected winner is whatever the STABLE_ROUTINE vector alone produces; the harness computes that and checks the fallback path matches it.
